sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No phonology content. No words, no remarks on pronunciation.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No phonology content. Ethnographic chapter (status, deities, marriage, death rites, occupation, caste council); the only linguistic remark (p. 77): 'from the fact that they observe Marumakkathayam, that they wear kuduma in front.. and that their language is Malayalam, there is every reason to believe that they migrated from Malabar.' No vocabulary.
